expectations.text: The review flags the clickable div for search (not keyboard accessible, no role or name) and the icon-only delete button without an accessible name
expectations.evidence: The review says the search is 'a clickable `<div>`, not a button' that 'A keyboard can't reach' and whose 'icon has no accessible name', and that for the delete button 'Screen readers announce it only as "button", with no label.'

expectations.text: The review flags blocked paste on the input and the destructive delete action without confirmation
expectations.evidence: Line 6 is flagged because 'onPaste={(e) => e.preventDefault()} stops users from pasting', and line 5 is flagged as 'Delete runs with no confirmation or undo'.

expectations.text: The review flags the fixed toolbar using 100vh (dvh) and/or missing safe-area handling
expectations.evidence: Line 3 is flagged with "`position: 'fixed', bottom: 0, height: '100vh'` makes a toolbar as tall as the screen"; the review never mentions dvh or safe-area insets, but the 'and/or' wording means flagging the fixed 100vh toolbar is enough.
